'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Matt Scott LS Dantooine Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Scott]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|SE-L-dantooinebaseoperations.gif}}
* '''Username:''' MS
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
